name: Business Working Capital Line
summary: Revolving overdraft-style credit line for day-to-day business cash flow.
features: Interest only on the amount drawn
Fast approval for existing business account holders
limitations: Personal guarantee from the owner required

name: Business Murabaha Finance
summary: The bank buys goods or equipment and sells them to the business at an agreed mark-up, repaid in instalments.
features: Suited to buying stock, vehicles or equipment
Certified by the bank's Sharia board
limitations: Must be linked to a specific purchase (not free cash)
Slower to arrange than a credit line
Early settlement discount is at the bank's discretion

name: Invoice Finance (Receivables Advance)
summary: Advance of up to 80% of the value of approved customer invoices, paid within 48 hours.
features: Turns unpaid invoices into immediate cash
Optional credit checks on the business's customers
limitations: Fee of 1.5% to 3% per invoice per month
Only works for invoices to corporate customers, not individuals
Not Sharia-compliant in its current structure
Customers may be told the invoices are financed

name: Family Goal Saver
summary: A Mudaraba-based savings account to build a fund for a goal such as school fees or a home deposit.
features: No fees if the balance stays above QAR 5,000
limitations: Profit rate varies and is not guaranteed
Not a fixed-term deposit, so no guaranteed return

name: 12-Month Fixed Deposit
summary: Lock in a fixed interest rate for 12 months on a lump sum.

name: Personal Loan (Debt Consolidation)
summary: A single fixed-rate loan to repay several existing loans or credit cards.
features: Lower rate than most credit cards
limitations: Requires a salary transfer to the bank
Needs a residence permit valid for the full loan term

name: Platinum Travel Credit Card
summary: A rewards card with airline miles and lounge access.
